01 / THE METHODOLOGYRGJ / TIJUANA

MORE THAN
A FIGHT.

Body. Mind. Spirit.

Roots in Brazil. A heart in Tijuana.

The Rocian Gracie Jr. Teaching Methodology connects body, mind, and spirit through jiu-jitsu. A structured progression, from your first time on the mat to more advanced stages.

We are the Tijuana academy in the Rocian Gracie Jr network. A meeting place in Playas to discover what you are capable of and keep growing.
